AC AMENDMENTS (plan-review F1 + F4):

**F1 (post-S2 signature)**: Tests must assert that the single append_cycle call passes pr_number AND commit_sha matching the fixture (NOT just call count). Test is written against the POST-S2 signature so it fails today (RED) and passes after both S2 and T6 land.

**F4 (failure modes)**: Add RED test cases for:
- Aggregation LLM returns malformed JSON \xe2\x86\x92 expected behavior: falls back to un-aggregated per-cluster results with visibility comment 'aggregation failed; per-cluster findings posted separately'.
- .gitattributes parse failure \xe2\x86\x92 expected behavior: fail-open (all files included as reviewable; warning logged).
- Per-file schema-correction exhaustion \xe2\x86\x92 expected behavior: skip that file (do NOT abort aggregation); note 'schema-correction-exhausted: <file>' in aggregation output.

- [ ] Test asserts pr_number value in append_cycle call (not just count)
  Verify: grep -qE 'append_cycle.*pr_number|pr_number=' tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_aggregator.py
- [ ] Test covers all 3 failure modes
  Verify: grep -cE 'malformed.*aggreg|gitattributes.*parse|schema.*exhaust' tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_aggregator.py | awk '{exit ($1>=3?0:1)}'
